We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We are hiring a Paid Media Specialist - a performance-driven marketer with a strong command of paid media strategy, campaign execution, and data analysis. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms.
You’ll report to the Managing Director of Growth and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands. You’ll be responsible for owning campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.
This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.
Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Barcelona, Brazil, and Colombia.
 What you'll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies to increase brand visibility and recognition and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.
  • Manage between 5-10 paid media accounts (including but not limited to: Google/YouTube Ads, Pinterest, Facebook/Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other social platforms like Twitter and TikTok) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $25,000 - $1M.
  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.
  • Understand important KPI and industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.
  • Implement real-time and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms.
  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.
  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.
  • Understand digital marketing best practices and readily contribute to overarching marketing strategies to ensure client success across the board - even if it's paid media adjacent or outside of channel control.
  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new acquisition, list growth, e-commerce, website CRO, retention, and overall client success based on marketing discussions and strategies that work in tandem with paid media and performance efforts.
  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy
What you'll need to be successful:
  • 5+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience preferred (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
  • 5+ years minimum managing paid search and paid social advertising for growth clients, or clients spending $100k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.
  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and creative
  • Experience in keyword targeting and audience optimization across multiple platforms
  • Background in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert
  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results
  • Experience using Google Analytics to develop insights and report them to stakeholders
What It's Like To Work At Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

No Brasil, o BBS foi implantado em 2014 e atualmente está concentrado na cidade de Gaspar (SC), contando ainda com colaboradores alocados em diversas outras unidades da Bunge no Brasil. Atualmente, o BBS conta com um time multidisciplinar de cerca de 579 colaboradores, que têm como foco a migração e manutenção de serviços transacionais de todas as cadeias de valor da Bunge. A equipe também apoia a transformação digital da empresa por meio da adoção de tecnologias, análise de dados, automação e inovação, além de possuir uma atuação estratégica definida por indicadores de performance.

Our team in Brazil is growing, we are currently recruiting for an Automation Designer to join our Minerals and Metals Business line in the Belo Horizonte office.

About the role:

  • Work on engineering projects during the conceptual, basic, and detailed phases in the disciplines of Automation, Instrumentation, and Telecommunications.
  • Participate in the preparation and review of instrumentation and automation project documents, such as: Instrument layout plan, P&ID instrumentation, control system configuration, and automation setup.

  • Analyze vendor drawings and provide technical support for on-site implementation.

About you:

  • Experience in executive engineering projects in the Mining and Steel sectors;
  • Experience in 3D modeling in an integrated environment (BIM);
  • Experience with control systems (DCS/PLC and SCADA);

  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, AutoCAD / Volo View, Revit, Navis, and Plant3D;

Why Ausenco?

We support individual growth and aim to allow you to work in a way that plays to your strengths and cover your needs.

  • Career advancement - Be supported in your ongoing development with technical training, mentoring programs and frequent networking opportunities.
  • Balance and Wellness – Take a proactive approach to your overall wellbeing. Access to confidential counselling, health services and a benefits program that supports your needs.

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities:

  • Bogota, Colombia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Senior Digital Construction Coordinator , you'll be responsible for overseeing information management using BIM (Building Information Modeling) across the project, ensuring all stakeholders meet digital deliverables and project requirements. While the role may involve other digital construction methods such as scanning, drones, and robotics, the primary focus is BIM. The coordinator serves as the main point of contact for BIM between the project management team and external stakeholders including the client, consultants, and subcontractors.

Your Role:

  • Manage and interpret client BIM expectations and deliverables.
  • Communicate information requirements internally and externally.
  • Develop and maintain BIM documentation such as the BIM execution plan, exchange information requirements, responsibility matrix, and master information delivery plan.
  • Set up and manage BIM workflows from contract award through project handover.
  • Ensure the electronic document management system supports the common data environment processes.
  • Lead 3D model coordination and issue resolution, including clash detection.
  • Provide training, coaching, and support for BIM processes and related technologies.
  • Estimate resource requirements for direct and subcontracted works.
  • Implement quality assurance and control for models and BIM processes.
  • Represent BIM and digital construction at project meetings.
  • Report on BIM progress and compliance at the project level.
  • Support tender submissions and contribute to departmental process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and familiarity with the 1192 standards.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring software such as Revit, Tekla, or Archicad.
  • Experience with BIM coordination tools such as Navisworks or Revizto.
  • Knowledge of openBIM standards including IFC and COBie.
  • Ability to use tools for automated model checking and data validation such as Solibri.
  • Experience with cloud-based collaboration platforms used in CDE workflows such as Aconex or BIM 360.
  • Familiarity with scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Experience in programming or visual programming (Dynamo preferred).
  • Understanding of 4D and 5D processes and their implementation.
  • Ability to use data reporting tools such as MS Power BI.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable with a proactive mindset.
  • Confident, assertive, and resilient under pressure.
  • Analytical with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Highly organized with excellent time management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

The right candidate will be a strategic thought leader who is driven by learning and solving ambiguous problems.
Performance Solutions delivers through strategic guidance, operational excellence and technical expertise to improve the effectiveness of advertising campaigns resulting in increased client ROI. We're looking for a talented and passionate Art Director to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team working from Sao Paulo.
Our Art Directors are creative leaders that create and maintain the artistic vision of our products at Wildlife Studios. The Art Director will be an inspirational leader, the torch-bearer for our art department who empowers our team to envision visually stunning mobile games for the global community.
We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

  • Team Building: You will work with Art Managers and Recruiting to build staffing plans that help achieve both the short-term and long-range goals of the team.
What You'll Need
  • Leadership and hands on experience in one or more art subject areas such as concept, 3d modeling, real-time VFX, animation, illustration, etc.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • A resume and an online portfolio showcasing your ability to create and carry a vision for a creative product.

  • Organization: You have experience helping create and lead schedules that ensure accurate workflow throughout the art department.
  • Resourcefulness: You have an ability to run a group of artists in a dynamically changing game production environment.
  • Visual Range: You have an ability to work within a wide range of artistic styles and themes to compliment various genres of games.

About The Team
Process & Tooling Productivity Product Manager | SAP Application Foundation
The Application Foundation Team owns the mission of improving efficiency across SAP and enabling the Application and Service Teams to deliver value to customers at low cost.
The Application Foundation Productivity team’s mission is to drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity through the harmonization of internal platforms and streamlined processes. This cross-functional team works across a wide range of domains, including—but not limited to—product standards, security, compliance, cost optimization, and reporting.   • Strong people skills, driving, understanding and leading people to successful outcomes

Comprometidos com o desenvolvimento e a melhoria contínua, estamos em constante evolução, colocando a experiência de nossos colaboradores no centro de nossas preocupações de gestão.

Estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde talento pode encontrar espaço para prosperar e se desenvolver. Prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, plural e que valoriza o respeito, a ética e a igualdade de oportunidades para todos!

As nossas oportunidades podem abranger diferentes áreas da empresa:

  • Saúde e Segurança
  • Mineração
  • Produção
  • Manutenção
  • Tecnologia da Informação

Se você possuir alguma deficiência, inscreva-se nesse link e aguarde o nosso contato!

Em troca, oferecemos-lhe:

Um ambiente cheio de desafios, como oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nossa fábrica possui um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso e alegre, resultado da nossa cultura.

Juntar-se a nós é fazer a diferença, iniciando iniciativas, transformando dificuldades em oportunidades e colocando seu talento a serviço de um esforço coletivo, em uma mudança compartilhada: Crescer Juntos é caminhar juntos na mesma direção.

Fundada em 1905, a Magnesium do Brasil foi 100% adquirida pelo Grupo Roullier em 2021 – multinacional francesa com faturamento anual superior a 4 bilhões de euros, mais de 10.400 colaboradores e presença em todos os continentes.

Da extração ao tratamento da matéria-prima e com grandes esforços em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Magnesium do Brasil tem por missão revelar o potencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência global nos mercados de nutrição animal, fertilizantes, aplicações refratárias e outras aplicações industriais.

Após a aquisição de 100% pelo Grupo Roullier, sustentada por um importante processo de investimento em capacidade produtiva, a empresa consolida-se como fornecedor sólido e confiável para o mercado.

A Magnesium do Brasil mantém um firme compromisso com a responsabilidade socioeconômica-ambiental, tendo um impacto significativo no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores e das comunidades onde está inserida.

Espírito de equipe, segurança, desenvolvimento, responsabilidade e inovação são os valores que integram o DNA da Magnesium do Brasil.

Job Description

  • We're looking for: A motivated self-starter who can handle a high-velocity sales approach while providing an excellent customer experience! Our Digital Inside Sales Specialists are at the forefront of our customer experience for both new and existing customers of Zendesk. In the role, you will become a product expert and articulate the value of Zendesk to an informed buyer. You will do this by providing several touch points across the customer journey to help them have an informed buying decision. This is a new team at Zendesk, so you will be one of the founding members in what will be a fast-growing area for our business.

  • Ideal candidates joining our team will bring a consistent track record in achieving targets; Software/SaaS experience is a plus. Travel to a Zendesk office is required throughout training and then will move to a hybrid schedule.

  • Responsibilities

    • Respond to a large number of inbound leads and existing customers through various channels, primarily through chat and email.

    • Actively resolve prospect and customer inquiries to drive online business conversion rates

    • Become an expert on Zendesk products

    • Be the voice of our customers; understand their needs and make them champions

    • Meet or exceed SLAs and KPIs established for the role, including but not limited to: ticket volumes, response and resolution times, and productivity. You will also have a shared revenue target to contribute to.

    • Exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue goals on a weekly basis

  • Required

    • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Will require working with clients/prospects across Zendesk’s global market

    • 1+ years of sales experience; software/SaaS experience preferred

    • Real passion for Zendesk technology and quick ability to learn tools and processes

    • Outstanding organizational skills, with the ability to multitask a high volume of opportunities at all times

    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, think strategically and excel at tactical execution against a task

Where We Work

Zendesk is not your average tech company. We have all the stuff you’d expect - competitive pay, benefits, appealing offices, snacks, and more. We also have a culture deeply dedicated to enabling conversations and providing appreciative support. We help our staff keep work-life balance, from flexible hours to remote work, to the most dynamic parental leave plans on the market. Our Social Impact team is actively engaged in our community and enables us to invest thousands of hours with local community groups each year. We invest in diversity and inclusion so that our team reflects the diversity of the world around us. We have a whole crew dedicated to ensuring our workplace experience is top notch and welcoming for all.

Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

The intelligent heart of customer experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here .

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to with your specific accommodation request.

About Us

Zendesk is on a mission to simplify the complexity of business and make it easy for companies and customers to create connections.

Our customer experience software unlocks the power of billions of interactions, enabling businesses to build rich, meaningful relationships with their customers.

More meaningful moments. Fewer Zoom calls.

What’s it like to work here? Our offices reflect the global cities we call home, and have spaces for collaboration, quiet, and events.

With our hybrid approach, you’ll experience flexibility and connection, collaboration, and learning with your team.

Recruitment Scam Alerts

We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent Zendesk. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official Zendesk communications are conducted through "@ zendesk.com " email addresses. Junior CMMS Engineer, Maintenance and Inventory

Date Posted: 31 Jul 2025

Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Job Summary:

As a Junior CMMS Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring optimal maintenance and inventory processes within our Offshore Production business unit.

This position requires not only strong analytical and communication skills but also a hands-on approach to supporting end users and maintaining system data integrity.

You will be a key contributor to our continuous improvement initiatives, working collaboratively with various teams to enhance our operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide ongoing support for Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) activities across all operating assets in Brazil, fostering a seamless operational environment.
  • Deliver hands-on training to end-users on IFS CMMS and related maintenance and inventory processes, ensuring their competence and confidence in utilising the system.
  • Monitor CMMS system usage, advocate best practices, and implement efficiencies to protect the integrity and functionality of the system.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and enhancement of Maintenance & Inventory KPIs across Brazil’s operational units, providing insight that drives performance.
  • Support the Functional Manager and Operational Managers in analysing maintenance and inventory performance, facilitating informed decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency within the CMMS, collaborating effectively with team members to uphold high standards.
  • Actively participate as a member of the Support Issue team, executing tasks and responsibilities related to maintenance and inventory support.
  • Advocate for the use of CMMS, underscoring the importance of defined processes, tools, and standards within the team and broader organisation.

Duties:

  • Participate actively in meetings as required, engaging with the ALM Maintenance and Inventory team to foster collaboration and communication.
  • Conduct regular reviews and analyses of maintenance-related KPIs for Brazilian units, identifying areas for improvement and driving operational excellence.
  • Perform both offshore and onshore site visits as necessary to aid in system usage and facilitate training opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support integrated processes that encompass maintenance and inventory management.
  • Provide necessary budget input to asset Operation Managers as required, ensuring financial prudence within the Brazil units.
  • Carry out additional tasks and responsibilities as required, contributing to the broader goals of the department.

Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Structural, Mechanical, Marine, or Offshore Engineering, or equivalent education and relevant industry experience.
  • Experience in the offshore maintenance industry, specifically with comparable ERP systems, with preference given to those who have worked with IFS.
  • Experience in strategy optimisation is advantageous, enabling you to influence process improvements effectively.
  • Proven experience in working in a global environment, collaborating successfully with diverse teams.

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of addressing complex challenges effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills that foster collaboration and respect across teams.
  • Exceptional organisational and administrative skills, with a keen attention to quality, detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industry standards and regulations, ensuring compliance at every level of operation.

Join our dynamic team at Yinson and contribute to shaping the future of offshore production. We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where diverse perspectives are valued and innovation is encouraged. We look forward to seeing how your unique skills and experiences can enhance our operations.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Como Product Designer Sênior, você será responsável pela evolução da Brandpage do Reclame AQUI, o principal ponto de contato entre as empresas e milhões de consumidores. Sua missão é ir além da execução técnica, liderando iniciativas de design de ponta a ponta que resolvem problemas complexos e geram impacto direto nos resultados de negócio das marcas que confiam em nossa plataforma.

Atuando na tribo de Empresas, você terá autonomia e responsabilidade de aprofundar o entendimento sobre as dores e necessidades das marcas, traduzindo insights de dados e pesquisas em soluções de experiência e interface intuitivas e eficazes, ajudando as empresas a construir e gerenciar sua reputação de forma estratégica.

Esperamos que você atue com alto grau de ownership, influenciando a visão do produto, colaborando com Produto e Tecnologia, e elevando a qualidade do design no produto e no Reclame AQUI.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Dados: Familiaridade com análise de indicadores de produto e negócio para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  2. Pensamento Sistêmico: Desejo de desenvolver sua capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica, entendendo como as ferramentas de design impactam e interagem em um ecossistema maior.
  3. Mapeamento de Jornadas e Processos: Conhecimento em mapeamento de jornadas de produto e serviço, identificando dores e necessidades que, ao serem resolvidas, melhoram processos de trabalho.
  4. Storytelling: Comunicação e apresentação do trabalho de forma organizada, estruturada e objetiva, engajando partes interessadas e transmitindo o valor do design.
  5. Visual Design: Experiência na concepção, criação e prototipação de interfaces para diferentes plataformas.
  6. UX Design: Aplicação de princípios de design centrado no usuário, incluindo pesquisa, criação de personas, mapeamento de jornada do usuário e cenários de uso.
  7. Content Design: Habilidade na escrita de textos claros e concisos, alinhados à estratégia de experiência da solução.
  8. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas quantitativas, qualitativas e testes de usabilidade para explorar, validar e iterar soluções de design.
  9. Ferramentas: Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Miro, Useberry, VWO, Jira e similares.
  10. Empatia e Adaptabilidade: Forte capacidade de entender e antecipar necessidades de clientes e colegas, adaptando-se a mudanças.
  11. Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades para articular ideias complexas para stakeholders de todos os níveis.
  12. Pensamento Crítico: Facilidade para analisar problemas complexos e trabalhar proativamente em soluções.
  13. Atenção a Detalhes: Compromisso com a qualidade das entregas.
  14. Proatividade e Colaboração: Vontade de buscar melhorias, colaborar e promover uma cultura positiva de design.

Requisitos:

  1. Proficiência em Análise de Dados: Capacidade de analisar métricas de produto e indicadores de negócio, identificando problemas, validando hipóteses e medindo impacto.
  2. Pensamento Sistêmico: Capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica, entendendo a conexão das soluções da Brand Page com o ecossistema maior de produtos.
  3. Storytelling e Articulação: Excelência na comunicação e apresentação de trabalho, defendendo decisões de design e influenciando stakeholders.
  4. Visual Design: Experiência avançada em planejamento, concepção e prototipação de interfaces para plataformas web, com atenção a detalhes e princípios de UI.
  5. UX Design: Domínio na aplicação de princípios de design centrado no usuário, liderando criação de jornadas, personas e arquitetura da informação.
  6. UX Research: Experiência na condução de pesquisas completas, desde planejamento até análise de resultados.
  7. Content Design: Habilidade na criação de textos claros, concisos e alinhados à voz da marca.
  8. Ferramentas: Domínio de Figma, Useberry, Maze, Jira, Miro, além de curiosidade por novas ferramentas.
  9. Habilidades comportamentais: Empatia, visão de negócio, comunicação, influência, pensamento crítico, autonomia, ownership, colaboração e liderança pelo exemplo.

Descrição da vaga

In the position of SENIOR ORACLE DBA ANALYST, you will join the global Oracle team, with the mission of supporting, optimizing, and leading database infrastructure initiatives in alignment with Bosch’s standards for performance, security, and high availability.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide Level 2 support for Oracle infrastructure services across global Bosch locations;

  • Coordinate implementation of database environments and support Oracle deployments in Bosch plants;

  • Monitor performance, availability, and overall health of Oracle database systems;

  • Manage incidents, service requests, alerts, and configurations related to Oracle systems;

  • Build and maintain monitoring and logging tools;

  • Document issues and resolution steps;

  • Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate teams;

  • Execute and optimize operational processes, review procedures and related documentation;

  • Contribute to global IT operations by implementing, upgrading, replacing, and extending Oracle database solutions;

  • Analyze trends and propose improvements or innovations for Oracle technologies;

  • Participate in on-call rotations and provide support during off-hours (redlines, after-hours availability).

Qualificações

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience;

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – mandatory;

  • Strong experience in Oracle database administration, including:

    • Migrations and upgrades for large databases;

    • Cloning, patching, tuning, and performance optimization;

    • Oracle Data Guard, RMAN, exp/imp and Data Pump;

    • RAC (Real Application Clusters) and High Availability environments;

    • Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM – Cloud/Grid Control);

    • Multitenant architecture (CDB and PDB);

  • Good understanding of server, network, and storage infrastructure;

  • Experience with virtualization technologies (on-prem and cloud);

  • Scripting knowledge (e.g., PowerShell, VBA, Python, Ansible, CI/CD, GIT) is a plus;

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and information security standards in enterprise environments;

  • Experience in scalable, high-performance system design, including data modeling and integration;

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills;

  • Ability to lead and mentor team members, adapting to evolving technologies;

  • Strong communication skills for interacting with international teams and stakeholders;

  • Customer-focused approach with initiative, collaboration, and accountability.

Nice to have:

  • IT certifications (Oracle, ITIL);

  • Experience in system requirement gathering and database architecture design;

  • Interest in automation and innovation within database operations;

  • Ability to propose and implement proactive solutions to avoid recurring issues.

title: Implementation Project Manager
description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic and has experienced rapid growth since our founding in 2021, driven by a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a talented team. We serve customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps across 40+ countries and are approaching the industry’s #1 position.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact and being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s innovate together—making ads clean and cool again with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team values straightforward communication, embracing feedback, and fostering a collaborative environment. We operate like a sports team focused on winning, with internal collaboration and external competitiveness. We prioritize open work, mutual support, and a sense of urgency, avoiding endless meetings—if it can be done today, we do it today.

What is this role like?

We’re seeking a highly skilled Project Manager with strong product instincts and deep technical expertise. You will lead complex initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and business teams to translate technical possibilities into real product value. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment and help shape our platform’s future.

  • Manage customer onboarding to ensure successful outcomes, driving growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to train customers on using Topsort’s platform and features effectively.
  • Set KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.
  • Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success team by documenting client stakeholder roles.
  • Improve onboarding processes and training materials to enhance the experience.
  • Coordinate with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Work with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.
  • Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate user training and workshops to empower clients effectively.

What (we think) you need to be successful

We’re open to candidates who may not check all boxes but can demonstrate exceptional skills and potential.

  • Minimum of 3 years experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.
  • PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Proven success in delivering projects efficiently and on time.
  • Understanding of Webhooks and APIs.
  • Experience with AI-driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, or Marketing Automation platforms.

What We Value

We seek professionals who embody these qualities:

  • Attention to detail: Dive deep to uncover root causes and optimal solutions.
  • Team first: Prioritize collective results over personal recognition.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Tackle open-ended problems and turn chaos into structured innovation.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to learn, mentor, lead, and follow as needed.
  • Urgency: Act with a sense of urgency while building scalable, repeatable processes.
  • Curiosity: Quickly learn and apply new concepts effectively.

If you think you’re a good fit, we’d love to hear from you!

description:

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities:

  • Bogota, Colombia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.

Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction

What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Detail-oriented and analytical mindset
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive attitude
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Description

At Amazon, we treat every single day like it's day one. We never sit still while we do it.

Are you ready to craft solutions and solve tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you!

We’re seeking a Delivery Station Manager to join our Amazon Logistics team in Vitoria - ES. You’ll operate out of one of our dynamic Delivery Stations, which are at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing Operations and Logistics network. These stations are where we sort and process parcels.

As a Delivery Station Manager, you’ll provide inspiring and supportive leadership to your team. You’ll also be actively involved in rolling up your sleeves and engaging directly whenever necessary.

You’ll be responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their reports, reporting to the Senior Operations Manager. Your leadership quality is crucial: you’ll motivate and inspire your teams, plan schedules, and balance their needs with business objectives.

Another key aspect is leading process improvement projects to streamline activities, with your innovative ideas potentially being implemented across the Amazon network. This is a significant opportunity for impact.

  • Maintain Health and Safety standards and promote a safety culture on-site;
  • Become proficient in specific processes within Delivery Stations, such as 5S audits;
  • Handle data collection and update operations metrics hourly;
  • Aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce costs, eliminate errors, and ensure excellent customer experience;
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, Security, and IT teams on staffing and performance;
  • Implement process changes and contribute to cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives.

Amazon is committed to diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, disability, or other protected statuses.

  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English skills.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Consultor de Recursos Humanos - HRBP Vendas
description:
Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI , GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

Liderar a agenda de HRBP para os canais de vendas (OT/CI) na Diretoria NENO e Divisão DTS Litoral, suportando a entrega de resultados através de soluções de recursos humanos aos parceiros de negócio. Está posição é o ponto focal suportando a tomada de decisão para líderes da área de negócio na região de cobertura, contemplando divisionais, GVs e supervisor de merchandising, sendo ponto focal de pessoas.Lidera a consultoria e influencia as agendas de Gestão de Talentos, Clima, Cultura, Diversidade, KPI’s, Reconhecimento, Gestão de mudança bem como demais atividades de People para as regiões atendidas elevando o nível do talento e diversidade.

O seu impacto

  • Atuação consultiva com abrangência nas regiões de atuação aos clientes das áreas de Vendas para cascateamento das estratégias e soluções de RH, liderando agendas e prioridades de RH para a região.
  • Gestão de clima e cultura com co-construção de estratégias de alavancagem destas em parceria com as lideranças dos nossos times de Vendas e áreas de suporte que atuam em nossos CDVs;
  • Atuação como OneHR ampliando a visão e atuação em parceria com as diferentes funções de RH (Vendas, WHS, Field Control, Transportes e Sass) com propósito de elevar nosso employee experience;
  • Desenvolver lideranças para uma atuação cada vez mais autônoma e focada no desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Apoiar na implantação de projetos transformacionais na região, suportando os aspectos de people, com foco especial em comunicação e change management.
  • Governança: liderar estratégias e planos de ação para KPIs e orçamentos de RH em suas localidades;
  • Organização: apoiar e propor estratégias que garantam desenhos de estruturas organizacionais e gestão de mudanças que conversem com os objetivos de negócio, suportanto a entrega de resultados;
  • Cultura e Diversidade: liderar na sua região a agenda e projetos que impactem o fortalecimento de nossa cultura e clime, tais como: pesquisa de clima, ações de engajamento, ações de reconhecimento, fortalecimento da diversidade entre outros;
  • Talentos: liderar na sua região a agenda de talento, participando ativamente e implementando estratégias de aquisição/gestão de talentos, mapeamento de sucessão, planos de desenvolvimento, ações de capacitação para liderança e Frontline, entre outros.
  • Participar de projetos transversais, sendo ponto focal de frentes de trabalho ou participando como membro do time de projetos.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Power Point, Word)
  • Conhecimento dos subsistemas de RH.
  • Perfil analítico e próativo(a) para resolução de problemas.
  • Necessário sólida atuação anterior em RH de grandes empresas e em ambientes de múltiplas atividades (como especialista tendo passado por diferentes áreas ou experiência em funções de HRBP/consultoria interna de RH, preferivelmente com área comercial).
  • Desejável pós-graduação/MBA/Cursos complementares.
  • Inglês ou Espanhol Intermediário (Desejável)
  • Serão considerados diferenciais: formação em coaching, formação em metodologias de assessment e team construction, formação em metodologias de gestão (PDCA, green belt, etc.), formação em Analytics, BI e Metodologias Ágil.

Differentiating Competencies Required

  • Pensamento: Traz e utiliza-se de ideias para ampliar a perspectiva e tomando decisões embasadas;
  • Relacionamento: Facilidade na construção de relações de confiança;
  • Execução: Tem energia e entusiasmo que inspira e motiva os demais ao redor, além de simplificar a complexidade e gerar resultados de qualidade;
  • Crescimento: Busca melhoria continua e é protagonista na sua própria evolução, em busca da alta performance.
  • Agilidade: Capacidade de navegar num contexto de complexidade e mudanças constantes, que exige resiliência e flexibilidade.

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Manager of Enterprise Operations at Toptal, you will drive cross-functional initiatives that support strategic direction, execution frameworks, workflow optimization, KPI development, and scalable team structures needed to fuel Toptal’s growth. Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Operations, you will act as a trusted advisor to tackle complex, high-impact challenges and contribute directly to outcomes that matter while partnering closely with senior leaders across the organization.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Working within our Customer team, you will scope initiatives, develop structured approaches, and help build comprehensive strategies to meet key objectives—delivering them with precision. You’ll collaborate with leaders and stakeholders to enable successful execution of major company initiatives that may result in new offerings, enhanced systems, or more efficient processes. Your ability to quickly understand the business, influence key decision-makers, develop actionable recommendations, and follow through to execution will define your impact. Upon delivery, you’ll continue to support or co-own the initiative to drive ongoing improvement and long-term value.

The life cycle of your projects will look like this: Approach initiatives with a consultant’s mindset—ask smart questions, learn quickly, and understand the broader business context. Think beyond constraints and develop frameworks that can enable significant impact, not just incremental change. Execute directly where needed and build infrastructure that can scale. Post-launch, ensure long-term sustainability by embedding processes and best practices that can live beyond you.

  • Strong communication skills—able to distill complex topics into actionable insights for a variety of audiences.
  • High integrity and adaptability in the face of evolving priorities.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast timelines, and high expectations.
  • You must be a hands-on contributor. This is not a role for directing from the sidelines.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Systems Architect (Data Modelling), Brasil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 7,400 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

We are looking for a Senior Architect with strong Data experience to join our team working for EMEA clients. In this position, you will lead the design of software solutions, working closely with teams in the EU, Brazil, and other Latin American countries.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Solid experience designing, developing, and deploying pipelines, data lakes, data meshes, and other data products;
  • Strong ability to understand, question, prioritize, and translate business problems into data solutions (BI, Analytics, models, machine learning);
  • Experience with AWS Data Platform (Glue, S3);
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines;
  • Ability to share knowledge with junior team members.

The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop and maintain conceptual data models related to Financial Services;
  • Evaluate and select appropriate modeling methodologies (e.g., Star Schema vs. Data Vault);
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define analytical questions and translate them into metrics;
  • Identify and catalog the Data Universe: source systems, data domains, key entities;
  • Design canonical schemas and logical models with consistent naming conventions, data types, and partitioning strategies;
  • Architect and recommend Lakehouse solutions (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Hudi);
  • Leverage existing Data Lake assets to build out the Data Universe;
  • Implement dimensional modeling patterns (star schemas or Data Vault) with defined grain, keys, and SCD handling;
  • Specify and oversee ETL/ELT pipelines to ensure data quality, lineage, and observability;
  • Establish governance standards for data stewardship, access, and metadata management;
  • Optimize schemas and storage for performance, scalability, and cost;
  • Maintain documentation, including data dictionaries, ER diagrams, and architecture diagrams.

Additional knowledge areas that are beneficial:

  • Non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, GDPR);
  • Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, and Clean Coding;
  • Unit, integration, and E2E testing knowledge.

Benefits include:

  • Health and dental insurance;
  • Meal and food allowance;
  • Extended paternity leave;
  • Partnerships with gyms and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
  • Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
  • Life insurance;
  • Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
  • Discount club;
  • Free online platform for physical, mental, and overall well-being;
  • Pregnancy and responsible parenting courses;
  • Partnerships with online learning platforms.

At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. This ensures the support and accommodations you deserve. If you do not have the assessment yet, we can support you in obtaining it.

We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups to support you at every stage. Join us in this journey.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

Acreditamos que, por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo, podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para esses produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;

  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.
Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you
Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.
Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.
This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.
The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study
Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.
Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you
Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.
Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.
This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study
Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. description:

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.

ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.
  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.
  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.
  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.
  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.
  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients. We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.
For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.
At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. In This Role, You Will

Huggies. Kleenex. Cottonelle. Scott. Kotex. Poise. Depend. Kimberly-Clark Professional. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. We’re founded on more than 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly-Clark.

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.

You love what you do, especially when the work you do makes a difference. At Kimberly-Clark, we’re constantly exploring new ideas on how, when, and where we can best achieve results. When you join our team, you’ll experience Flex That Works: flexible (hybrid) work arrangements that empower you to have purposeful time in the office and partner with your leader to make flexibility work for both you and the business.

Education Required
